notes: Custom Finnish webshop platform. All products render on a single page with no pagination controls (24 cards for a stated '28 tuotetta' — 4 of the counted products never reach the HTML, so a small coverage gap is expected). in_stock selector is inverted: presence of '.out-of-stock' (badge text 'Tilapäisesti loppu') means OUT of stock — absence of this element within the product container means in-stock. max_price is raised to 5000 because this shop lists whole factory cases ('tehdaslaatikko', 2400-3800 €) that the default 2000 € guard would drop as suspicious; one pre-order card carries a 1,00 € placeholder price that the lower bound correctly rejects.
